prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Sign In to Keep & Sync Your Companion", "Signing in ensures your pet data, custom traits, and companion progress are safely backed up and synced."]
1: ["Choose Your Companion Traits", "Select personality and visual traits to tailor your companion before finalizing adoption.", "Select Trait"]
2: ["Master Your Desktop Pet Controls", "Right-click your pet for commands, double-click to interact, or drag to reposition anywhere on your desktop.", "Get Started"]
3: ["Pick Your Pet Journey", "Choose whether to create a custom pet from photos or select a pre-made companion instantly."]
4: ["Already have a pet? Sign in with your original account to automatically sync and restore your companion."]
5: ["Initializing desktop graphics engine... Your pet will appear on your desktop shortly."]
6: ["Verified Desktop Companion"]
7: ["Tip: Right-click your desktop pet anytime to open quick controls and settings."]
8: ["Select Your Desktop Companion Path", "Choose Instant Companion for pre-made pets, or Custom Creator to build your companion from photos."]
9: ["Upload Clear Pet Photos", "Provide clear, well-lit photos of your pet from different angles for optimal 3D generation results."]
